row.body: A bottle tally is checked off before the delivery crate arrives; one jar is marked for a worker who never signed the shift sheet.
row.title: The bottle count

sidecar.gloss: A bottle delivery is counted before arrival and one worker is unaccounted for.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could collect the same supplies and miss a signature; the tally does not say why the worker was absent.
